steps.name: Install local desktop and OCR dependencies
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update -qq
sudo apt-get install -y python3 python3-tk python3-dbus python3-gi libglib2.0-bin libx11-6 libxss1 libxres1 xvfb openbox x11-utils x11-xserver-utils fonts-dejavu-core tesseract-ocr tesseract-ocr-chi-sim libnotify-bin dunst dbus-x11

steps.name: Install and compile canonical inputs
steps.run:
cd chrome-extension && npm ci
cd ../companion && npm ci && npm run build
npx tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
